entries.source_hypothesis: LP2 0-54 is OTP-class: a full-length keystream under a soft anti-repeat filter (~83% suppression). The ciphertext is indistinguishable between a TRUE EXTERNAL PAD (information-theoretically closed) and a SHORT-SEED DERIVED keystream (finite keyspace, brute-forceable).
LP2 0-54 is information-theoretically unsolvable; no compute recovers it; unsolvable-by-design.

entries.source_hypothesis: The anti-repeat rule is enforced on the CIPHERTEXT, not on the keystream and not on the plaintext. Seven loci were formalised and simulated: no filter (M0), ciphertext key-skip (M1, the repo's pinned model), ciphertext value-rewrite with the key staying aligned (M2), ciphertext deterministic nudge (M2n), keystream-filtered at generation (M3), plaintext-filtered before encipherment (M4), hard ciphertext rule (M5).
Rejection consumes keystream draws, so the keystream index is not the rune index. Quantify the drift, and determine which measured results in this repository depend on the alignment they assumed.

The skip-aware beam already infers how many keystream draws a candidate implies, but the repo's decoder discards the number.
